title: Which country will win the 2026 FIFA World Cup quarterfinal scheduled for July 11 in Kansas City?
background: The winner of this knockout match will advance to the semifinals of the men's World Cup.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : FIFA's official match result for the quarterfinal scheduled for July 11, 2026, in Kansas City. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the country whose national team wins the match and advances to the semifinals, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.
